evidence.quote: The year 1147 is the official date first fixed in 1780
considered by authoritative sources to be fictional

evidence.quote: The year 1264 was the first mention of Vologda

events.label: annexation
events.text: Vologda added to the Grand Duchy of Moscow

evidence.quote: In 1397 , during the reign of Vasily I , Vologda was added to the Grand Duchy of Moscow

events.label: personal possession
events.text: Vasily II exiled to Vologda and granted city as personal possession

evidence.quote: was defeated by Dmitry Shemyaka in 1447 , he swore to never start a war against Shemyaka

events.label: siege
events.text: Vologda besieged by troops of Dmitry Shemyaka, not occupied

events.label: inheritance
events.text: Vologda passed to Andrey Menshoy and became center of Principality of Vologda

evidence.quote: After the death of Vasily in 1462 , Vologda passed to the possession of his son Andrey Menshoy

events.label: annexation
events.text: Vologda passed to Ivan III and included in Grand Duchy of Moscow

evidence.quote: In 1481 , after the death of Andrey who had no successors , Vologda passed to Ivan III

events.label: trading office
events.text: England opened a trading office in the city

evidence.quote: in 1555 England opened a trading office in the city

events.label: oprichnina

events.label: capital decision

evidence.quote: That year , he visited the city for the first time and decided to make it the center of Oprichnina

events.label: fortress foundation

evidence.quote: supervise the foundation of the fortress on April 28 , 1566

events.label: Nason-gorod
events.text: Fortress territory named Nason-gorod

evidence.quote: Therefore , the territory of the fortress located in the new part of Vologda was named the Nason-gorod

events.label: cathedral construction began
events.text: Construction of Saint Sophia Cathedral began in new fortress

events.label: cathedral completed
events.text: Saint Sophia Cathedral completed, first stone building in Vologda

evidence.quote: Between 1568 and 1570 , a new cathedral was built in the new fortress

events.label: diocese center
events.text: Vologda became center of the Diocese of Vologda and Perm

evidence.quote: In 1571 , Vologda became the center of the Diocese of Vologda and Perm

events.text: Ivan the Terrible halted construction and left Vologda for good

evidence.quote: in 1571 Ivan the Terrible unexpectedly stopped the construction work in Vologda and left the city for good

events.text: Saint Sophia Cathedral consecrated during reign of Feodor I

evidence.quote: The consecration took place only during the reign his son Feodor I in 1587

events.text: Plague epidemic began the Time of Troubles for Vologda

evidence.quote: The Time of Troubles for Vologda began with a plague epidemic in 1605

evidence.quote: In 1608 , when Russia was split into areas controlled by Tsar Vasily Shuysky

evidence.quote: In 1612 , people of Vologda rendered sizable food and military help

evidence.quote: on September 22 , 1612 one of the Lithuanian extortionate groups seized Vologda without resistance

evidence.quote: in 1780 made Vologda the center of Vologda Viceroyalty

events.text: City center rebuilt according to provincial city plan issued 1781

events.text: Viceroyalty transformed into Vologda Governorate

evidence.quote: In 1796 , the viceroyalty , administered by a governor-general , was transformed into Vologda Governorate

events.text: Danish merchant opened first butter factory near Vologda, start of butter industry

events.label: railway

events.label: building purchase
events.text: City authorities bought Peter the Great's house

evidence.quote: which in 1872 was bought by the city authorities

events.text: Peter the Great house became memorial museum, first museum of Vologda

the first museum of Vologda ( opened in 1885 )

events.label: railway
events.text: Railway line to Arkhangelsk built

evidence.quote: with Arkhangelsk ( 1898 )

events.label: railway
events.text: Railway line to St Petersburg and Vyatka built

events.text: Fominskoye manor given to state, became base of Vologda dairy institute

events.label: Soviet power

evidence.quote: Soviet power was established in Vologda in December 1917

events.text: Diplomats compelled by Bolsheviks to leave Vologda

events.text: Vologda Governorate abolished and included in Northern Krai

evidence.quote: Regular bus service started in Vologda in 1929

events.label: front city
events.text: Finnish troops crossed into Vologda Oblast; Vologda became a front city

evidence.quote: In the fall of 1941 , Finnish troops crossed the borders of Vologda Oblast

events.label: trolleybus system

the trolleybus service was open in 1976

events.text: City administration formed; local government reform began

events.text: Soviets of Peoples Deputies at all levels abolished

evidence.quote: In October 1993 , the Soviets of Peoples Deputies of all levels were abolished

events.text: City Duma established after dissolution of Vologda Soviet

evidence.quote: On July 25 , 1996 , the City Duma adopted the main city document

events.label: mayoral election
events.text: First mayoral elections in Vologda history held

evidence.quote: On October 6 , 1996 , the first mayoral elections in the history of Vologda took place

evidence.quote: On October 6 , 1996 , the first mayoral elections
Alexey Yakunichev was elected and became the head of the city

events.label: ring road start
events.text: Construction of ring road started

evidence.quote: In 2003 , the construction of a ring road started

events.label: charter approved
events.text: City Duma approved the new Charter of Vologda

evidence.quote: On August 25 , 2005 , the City Duma approved the new Charter of Vologda

events.label: term ended
events.text: Alexey Yakunichev's term as city head ended

events.text: Yevgeny Shulepov elected City Head
